rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Look! Patterns on the window!
rows.heard: Look, patterns on the window.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Wow! So pretty!
rows.heard: Wow, so pretty!

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Вчера окно было чистое. Кто это нарисовал?
rows.text: Yesterday the window was clean. Who drew this?
rows.heard: Yesterday the window was clean. Who drew this?

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Someone came at night! An artist!
rows.heard: Someone came at night, an artist.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вижу… завитушку. И ещё одну. Художник очень старался.
rows.text: I see a curl. And another one. The artist worked really hard.
rows.heard: I see a curl and another one. The artist worked really hard.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Я ночью спал. Это не я.
rows.text: I was asleep. It wasn't me.
rows.heard: I was asleep, it wasn't me.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: No paint anywhere.
rows.heard: No paint anywhere!

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Значит, рисовали без красок. Вот это загадка!
rows.text: So it was drawn without paint. What a mystery!
rows.heard: So it was drawn without paint. What a mystery.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я поймаю художника! Я буду в засаде.
rows.text: I'll catch the artist! I'll hide and wait.
rows.heard: I'll catch the artist, I'll hide and wait.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Ron, where are you?
rows.heard: Ron, where are you?

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: I'm hiding. Shh!
rows.heard: I'm hiding SHH.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Will the artist come by day?
rows.heard: Will the artist come by day?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Днём солнце греет окно. Может, он рисует только ночью?
rows.text: In the day, the sun warms the window. Maybe he only draws at night?
rows.heard: In the day, the sun warms the window. Maybe he only draws at night.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Ночью на улице мороз. Всё замерзает.
rows.text: At night, it's frosty outside. Everything freezes.
rows.heard: And night it's frosty outside, everything freezes.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Jack Frost! He's the artist!
rows.heard: Jack Frost, he's the artist.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Мороз — это не художник. У него нет лап.
rows.text: Jack Frost isn't an artist. He has no paws.
rows.heard: Jack Frost isn't an artist. He has no paws.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: But he has ice!
rows.heard: But he has ice.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Пойдёмте на улицу. Посмотрим, где ещё мороз рисовал.
rows.text: Let's go outside and see what else Jack Frost drew.
rows.heard: Let's go outside and see what else Jack Frost drew.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Look! The trees are all white!
rows.heard: Look, the trees are all white.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Like someone sprinkled sugar on them.
rows.heard: like someone sprinkled sugar on them.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Это не снег. Снег — это хлопья. А тут колючие иголочки.
rows.text: It's not snow. Snow comes in flakes. These are prickly little needles.
rows.heard: It's not snow. Snow comes in flakes. These are prickly little needles.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Он называется иней. Бывает, когда ночью сильный мороз.
rows.text: It's called frost. It comes on very cold nights.
rows.heard: It's called frost. It comes on very cold nights.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Doesn't smell like sugar. Too bad.
rows.heard: Doesn't smell like sugar. Too bad.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Is frost yummy? I'll taste it!
rows.heard: Is frost yummy? I'll taste it.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Нет, Рон! На морозе ничего не лижем!
rows.text: No, Ron! No licking things in the cold!
rows.heard: No Ron, no licking things in the cold.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Язык может прилипнуть. Это очень больно.
rows.text: Your tongue can stick. That really hurts.
rows.heard: your tongue can stick, that really hurts.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Oh. Then I'll just sniff it.
rows.heard: Oh, then I'll just sniff it.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Where does frost come from?
rows.heard: Where does frost come from?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: В воздухе есть вода. Совсем маленькие капельки. Их не видно.
rows.text: There's water in the air. Teeny tiny drops. You can't see them.
rows.heard: There's water in the air. Teeny tiny drops. You can't see them.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Like steam from tea?
rows.heard: like steam from tea.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Да. Ночью они замерзают. И садятся на всё холодное.
rows.text: Yes. At night, they freeze. And land on cold things.
rows.heard: Yes, at night they freeze and land on cold things.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: So it's ice too?
rows.heard: So it's ice too.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Looks like it. Very pretty ice.
rows.heard: Looks like it. Very pretty ice.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Shh! Looking for the artist's tracks.
rows.heard: SHH looking for the artist's tracks.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Jack Frost leaves no tracks, Ron.
rows.heard: Jack Frost leaves no tracks wrong.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Sneaky.
rows.heard: a sneaky

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Look, a sled! Who wants a ride?
rows.heard: Look a sled who wants a ride.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Me! Pull me!
rows.heard: Me, poor me.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Oh. It won't go. The sled is stuck!
rows.heard: Oh, it won't go. The sled is stuck.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Они всю ночь стояли на морозе. Вот и примёрзли.
rows.text: It sat in the cold all night. So it froze to the snow.
rows.heard: It sat in the cold all night, so it froze to the snow.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: I'll help. I'm strong.
rows.heard: I'll help, I'm strong.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: The sled went. But I didn't.
rows.heard: The sled went, but I didn't.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Рон, ты тоже примёрз к снегу!
rows.text: Ron, you froze to the snow too!
rows.heard: Ron, you froze to the snow too.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Слышите? Снег под санками скрипит. Это тоже мороз.
rows.text: Hear that? The snow crunches under the sled. That's the cold too.
rows.heard: Hear that? The snow crunches under the sled. That's the cold too.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Crunch, crunch! Like the snow is talking.
rows.heard: Crunch, crunch, like the snow is talking.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А мне он шепчет, чтобы я не падал.
rows.text: And it whispers to me: don't fall!
rows.heard: And it whispers to me, don't fall.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: It's cold. Let's go have tea.
rows.heard: It's cold. Let's go have tea.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Ух, горячий. Смотрите, над чашкой пар!
rows.text: Ooh, it's hot. Look, steam over the cup!
rows.heard: Ew, it's hot. Look, steam over the cup.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Это и есть вода в воздухе?
rows.text: Is that the water in the air?
rows.heard: Is that the water in the air?

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Yes. Warm water floats up.
rows.heard: Yes, warm water floats up.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я тоже могу сделать пар! Ха-а-а!
rows.text: I can make steam too! Haaa!
rows.heard: I can make steam too. Haya!

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Рон, у тебя изо рта тоже пар!
rows.text: Ron, there's steam from your mouth!
rows.heard: Ron, there's steam from your mouth.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Когда мы дышим, из нас выходит тёплый пар.
rows.text: When we breathe, warm steam comes out.
rows.heard: When we breathe, warm steam comes out.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: There's water in me?
rows.heard: There's water in me.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: A little. Like everyone.
rows.heard: A little like everyone.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда я тоже умею рисовать, как мороз!
rows.text: Then I can draw like Jack Frost too!
rows.heard: Then I can draw like Jack Frost too.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Нет, Рон. Ты тёплый. Тёплое лёд растапливает.
rows.text: No, Ron. You're warm. Warm things melt ice.
rows.heard: No, Ron, you're warm. Warm things melt ice.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Let's check!
rows.heard: Let's check.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Haaa! Haaa!
rows.heard: 太又差了

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Look! The pattern's melting! A little hole!
rows.heard: Look the pattern is melting a little hole.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Дыхание тёплое. А тепло растапливает лёд.
rows.text: Breath is warm. And warmth melts ice.
rows.heard: Breath is warm and warmth melts ice.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Теперь я вижу двор. Там зима.
rows.text: Now I see the yard. It's winter there.
rows.heard: Now I see the yard. It's winter there.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: I'll use my finger.
rows.heard: I'll use my finger.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: There! That's me. A bear.
rows.heard: There, that's me, a bear.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Looks like a potato.
rows.heard: Looks like a potato.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: It's a bear in winter. He's chubby.
rows.heard: It's a bear in winter. He's chubby.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А я нарисую снежинку. Вот! Шесть лучиков.
rows.text: And I'll draw a snowflake. There! Six points.
rows.heard: And I'll draw a snowflake. There, six points.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я нарисую художника. Вот. Это Мороз. Он сердитый.
rows.text: And I'll draw the artist. There. It's Jack Frost. He's grumpy.
rows.heard: And I'll draw the artist. There it's Jack Frost. He's grumpy.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Рон, он не сердитый. Он просто холодный.
rows.text: Ron, he's not grumpy. He's just cold.
rows.heard: Ron, he's not grumpy. He's just cold.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: А ночью мороз нарисует новые узоры. Прямо поверх.
rows.text: And tonight, Jack Frost will draw new patterns. Right on top!
rows.heard: And tonight Jack Frost will draw new patterns right on top.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Давайте поиграем. Я говорю, а вы угадываете: тепло или холод?
rows.text: Let's play a game. I say something, and you guess: warm or cold?
rows.heard: Let's play a game. I say something and you guess. Warm or cold?

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Okay!
rows.heard: Okay.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Frost!
rows.heard: Frost.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Cold!
rows.heard: Cold.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Steam from tea!
rows.heard: Steam from tea.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Warm!
rows.heard: You warm?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Sled in the snow!
rows.heard: sled in the snow.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Cold! It froze!
rows.heard: Cold it froze.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Ron in hiding!
rows.heard: Ron in hiding.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Very cold! I sat there so long.
rows.heard: Very cold. I sat there so long.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я посмотрю, как мороз рисует. Хоть немножко.
rows.text: I'll watch Jack Frost draw. Just a little bit.
rows.heard: I'll watch Jack Frost draw just a little bit.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: He draws slowly. All night.
rows.heard: He draws slowly all night.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Then I'll sleep. I'll look in the morning.
rows.heard: Then I'll sleep. I'll look in the morning.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А мне сегодня снежинка на нос упала. Красивая, с лучиками.
rows.text: Today a snowflake landed on my nose. Pretty, with little points.
rows.heard: Today a snowflake landed on my nose, pretty with little points.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: С лучиками? А почему снежинки такие?
rows.text: With points? Why are snowflakes like that?
rows.heard: With points, wire snowflakes like that.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Это новая загадка. Завтра посмотрим на снежинки в лупу!
rows.text: A new mystery! Tomorrow, snowflakes under the magnifying glass!
rows.heard: A new mystery. Tomorrow, snowflakes under the magnifying glass.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Jack Frost, Ron's asleep. You can draw now!
rows.heard: Jack Frost runs asleep. You can draw now.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу поставить лайк и подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to like it and subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to like it and subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode.
